intent: A Sunken Shelf corsair's gown of wet-sand and driftwood bodice over a warm salt-ivory sailcloth bell skirt, with Naga teal kept to the waist sash and one hem stripe and tarnished brass trim; from the high camera it reads as a narrow sand top over a wide pale bell, not a teal robe.
requests: A shell or pearl material with a faint sheen: under the night preset's zero specular, salt white reads flat.
A centre skirt panel spanning both thighs, so a gown can hang as one closed cone instead of two leg panels meeting at a seam.
